healthy.name: Healthy Leaf
healthy.solution: No disease detected. Maintain regular irrigation, balanced nutrients, and periodic pest scouting.

blight.name: Early Blight
blight.solution: Remove infected leaves, improve airflow, avoid overhead irrigation, and apply copper fungicide as advised.

rust.name: Leaf Rust
rust.solution: Use resistant variety if possible, remove severe infection spots, and spray sulfur-based fungicide in early stage.

leaf_spot.name: Leaf Spot
leaf_spot.solution: Avoid water splashing, sanitize tools, and use bio-fungicide or mancozeb per label guidance.

powdery_mildew.name: Powdery Mildew
powdery_mildew.solution: Increase ventilation, avoid excess nitrogen, and spray potassium bicarbonate or sulfur-based control.
